sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that since there is no interim order, the trial is going on and another four witnesses are left to be examined i.e., the investigation officers are to be examined, recorded and that he would be satisfied if the direction may be issued to the trial Court to expedite the trial.
3.
In light of the submission, the criminal petition is dismissed.
However, the trial Court is directed to expedite the matter and dispose of the case preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
Registry is directed to send a copy of this Order to the trial Court through email.
